findings.issue: The yaml example is not a valid config shape. It puts `defaultConfig` under `app.routes.page:home`, but `app.routes` only takes route bindings. It also uses `gridProps: { md, xs }`, which the `page:home` defaultConfig schema does not accept. That schema is in plugins/home/src/alpha.tsx:62-71 and requires component, column, row, width and height. Anyone who copies this snippet ends up with a config that is ignored or fails validation.
findings.fix: Use the shape documented in docs/getting-started/homepage.md:192-220: `app: extensions: - page:home: config: defaultConfig: - component: HomePageUnreadNotifications` with `column`, `row`, `width` and `height` values, for example 0, 0, 6, 4.

findings.issue: The defaultConfig yaml example only gives `component: HomePageUnreadNotifications`. The `page:home` defaultConfigItemSchema (plugins/home/src/alpha.tsx:62-71) requires numeric `column`, `row`, `width` and `height`, so this snippet fails extension config validation.
findings.fix: Add `column`, `row`, `width` and `height` to the example item, for example column: 0, row: 0, width: 6, height: 4, so it matches docs/getting-started/homepage.md.

findings.issue: No test covers what happens when mark-as-read fails. That path (updateNotifications rejects, then toastApi.post is called with title 'Failed to mark notification as read' and status 'danger') is new error-handling code with no assertion. The plan did not ask for this test, but it is the card's only error path that has no test.
findings.fix: In the existing mark-as-read test, or in one more case, make updateNotifications reject once. Click Mark as read and assert, using findBy or an awaited flush, that toastApi.post was called with expect.objectContaining({ title: 'Failed to mark notification as read', status: 'danger' }).

findings.issue: The API mocks are cast with `as any` in every render (notifications, toast and signal APIs), and `emit` is typed `(msg: any) => void`. This turns off type checking on the fixtures. NotificationsPage.test.tsx in the same run passes the same kind of mocks without casts.
findings.fix: Drop the `as any` casts where TestApiProvider accepts partial mocks, as NotificationsPage.test.tsx does. Type `emit` as `((msg: NotificationSignal) => void) | undefined`.

passing: Correctness against change_plan.md: U01-U17 and U19 match their rules. The card covers refreshKey, signal-vs-polling effects, isMounted-guarded refresh, render order and deep links. The table highlight is applied only to matching rows and scrolls once per id. The page reads id via useSearchParams.
Type safety in source files: no new `any`. The severity key map uses `as const`. The optional prop is documented with TSDoc. yarn tsc passes.
Error handling: load error renders a translated message, mark-as-read failure posts a toast, nothing is swallowed silently, and no stack traces reach the UI.
Authz/PII: no new routes or server surface. The card only reads the signed-in user's notifications through the existing client.
Sensitive files: both package.json diffs only add the planned dependencies (no removals or downgrades). The yarn.lock delta is limited to those entries.
Headers/conventions: all new .ts/.tsx files carry the 2026 Apache header. No default React import. home-react changes keep exports unchanged.
Env fixtures: not applicable (frontend plugin, no validating config module introduced).
API reports: report.api.md and report-alpha.api.md drift is expected and deferred by plan decision (run `yarn build:api-reports` before a PR).
